items.extra_life_backpack:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a polished picture-book atlas for a 5-year-old child's mobile app, exactly six equal full-bleed panels in a perfectly aligned 2-column by 3-row grid. Row-major reading order; NO gutters, border, text, logos, speech bubbles, or smaller inset panels. Each of the SIX panels is ONE continuous scene and ONE camera viewpoint. Warm premium semi-realistic 3D illustrated realism: believable soft cloth, wood and skin textures; rounded child-friendly proportions, gentle expressive faces, beautiful soft morning/evening lighting. A consistent little Chinese kindergarten boy named Guoguo has short dark-brown hair, yellow long-sleeve shirt and denim overalls; his red-orange backpack is consistent. His mother wears a sage-green cardigan; kind female teacher wears an apricot blouse. Keep characters and clothing consistent across all six scenes.
Top-left panel 1: At a sunlit home table, Guoguo is slightly puzzled looking for his water bottle and paint pencils. His mother gently shows him a small illustrated checklist, with object pictograms only, NO letters or marks resembling text.
Top-right panel 2: At that same home table, Guoguo carefully puts a blue water bottle in his backpack side pocket and a small pencil case in the main compartment, one continuous scene.
Middle-left panel 3: ONE continuous balcony camera shot, mother supervising in background, Guoguo hangs a damp small blue handkerchief on a low safe drying rack while holding a different clean dry yellow handkerchief in his other hand. NO split scene, no inset and no close-up bubble. Keep balcony rail secure.
Middle-right panel 4: He checks a small picture book and folded light jacket beside the neatly packed backpack at the table, satisfied and focused.
Bottom-left panel 5: In kindergarten art class, he happily takes pencils from his backpack; blue water bottle stands beside him; female teacher smiles gently nearby.
Bottom-right panel 6: Warm cozy evening at home, Guoguo prepares his tidy backpack and clothes for the next morning while mother looks encouragingly on. Positive independence and calm. Every panel has its own complete spatial setting.
